## 3. Flagship Production Case Studies

### Strong Workout Tracker (2019 – Present)
- **Context**: Freelance
- **Summary**: One of the world’s leading workout and strength-training apps, with ~5,000,000 registered users, ~580,000 monthly active users (MAU), 185,000+ global App Store ratings (4.9 ★), and recognition from CNBC and The Verge. Long-term collaboration across major architectural milestones and core user-facing features.
- **Technologies**: Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, ActivityKit, Core Data, HealthKit
- **Scale & Ratings**: App Store: 4.9 ★ (185k+ ratings) • ~5M Registered Users • ~580k MAU
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/strong-workout-tracker-gym-log/id464254577
- **Key Engineering Contributions**:
  - **Strong 6.0 Refactoring (SwiftUI & Combine)**: Contributed to the major codebase refactoring adopting SwiftUI and Combine reactive pipelines, culminating in the landmark version 6.0 release.
  - **Live Activities & Dynamic Island Rest Timers**: Implemented and released the Live Activity and Dynamic Island feature displaying active workout rest timers directly on the iOS Lock Screen and Dynamic Island.
  - **xRM Formula Engine (Brzycki & Epley)**: Improved x Repetition Maximum (xRM — estimated best weight performance for x repetitions of a given set) accuracy by adding support for both Brzycki and Epley formulas across Personal Records, Charts, and workout analytics.
  - **Exercise List Caching, Filtering & Fuzzy Search**: Improved Exercise List caching for faster loading performance, refined filtering and sorting methods, and helped develop fuzzy search with real-time character highlighting.
  - **Customizable Themes, Diagnostics, Privacy & Maintenance**: Developed customizable themes and alternate app icons, built local database diagnostic tools, implemented GDPR and Apple Privacy Nutrition Label compliance, and handled ongoing app maintenance, bug/crash fixes, and technical support.

### SELECT — Your Community (2017 – 2019)
- **Context**: Beijing • Full-time
- **Summary**: Cross-platform social community application connecting people with shared interests. Contributed to both the native iOS codebase (v1.32–1.37) and the complete React Native rewrite (v1.38+).
- **Technologies**: Swift 3.0, React Native, Objective-C, WebSocket, MVVM, Fastlane, Jenkins
- **Scale & Ratings**: App Store: 5.0 ★ • Shipped on iOS & Google Play
- **App Store**: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/select-your-community/id1076478889
- **Key Engineering Contributions**:
  - **Native iOS Phase (v1.32–1.37) — Build Time Cut from 70 min to 11 min (-84%)**: Modularized the codebase using CocoaPods, refactored the architecture to MVVM with Dependency Injection, and configured Continuous Delivery using Fastlane and Jenkins.
  - **React Native Rewrite (v1.38+) — WebSocket Protocol & Core Features**: Defined and implemented the client/server WebSocket communication protocol, built the Multi Friend Selector (MFS) intelligent contact search and suggestion system, and built deep-link activated custom intro launch screens.
  - **Native Objective-C Image Picker & Cross-Platform Flexbox UI**: Built a custom Objective-C native image picker module bridged to React Native for optimal performance, and implemented responsive Flexbox screen layouts across iOS and Android.

Built for iOS 4.3+ with forward-thinking architecture that continued running on iOS 11 without major updates.

- **myPMU — L'information Hippique (v1.0)** (Horse Racing Information (iPhone & iPad)) [Objective-C / Core Data]: Took over a project already in development within a 3-developer iOS engineering team for France's premier horse-racing platform, responsible for custom UI implementation and Core Data local database support. (App Store: 4.6 ★ (45,400+ ratings)) — https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/pmu-turf/id719630042
- **Belles Demeures (v1.0)** (Luxury Real Estate (iPhone & iPad)) [Objective-C / UIKit]: Worked in a 3-developer team delivering full universal iPhone and iPad development and custom UI integration for 30,000+ prestige property listings across 10+ countries. (App Store: 4.8 ★ (3,100+ ratings)) — https://apps.apple.com/fr/app/belles-demeures/id398333286
- **Fédération Française du Bâtiment (FFB) — Déchets BTP** (Construction Waste Management (iOS 7 & Windows Phone 8)) [Objective-C & WP8 / Core Data]: Developed both the iOS 7 and Windows Phone 8 clients, handling REST API integration, navigation and UI implementation, and Core Data cache management.
